teaching_clarity.rationale: The delivery master preserves the complete worked argument: an apparently routine transfer becomes a rare human case; four control concepts separate; eight noncompensatory conditions fail independently; and the episode is repaired, exercised, receipted, bounded, and routed to safe hold.

composition.rationale: All 90 delivery-resolution beat samples and 87 caption-boundary frames remain legible at 1920 by 1080 and reduced review scale; the episode, reviewer, envelope, clocks, rails, channel, receipt, ceiling, privacy boundary, evidence airlock, and handoff preserve clear hierarchy.

motion_quality.rationale: Delivery-resolution motion retains semantic purpose: funnel traversal, independent-condition scan, time consumption, stop-path comparison, workload pressure, unavailable controls, safe-hold routing, exercised intervention, expiring admission, and bounded chapter handoff.

synchronization.rationale: The 30 audio-derived beats, exact 347.060-second delivery boundary, 87 caption cues, and delivery-resolution samples agree without accumulated drift or narration-visual contradiction.

continuity.rationale: The synthetic transfer episode and its control envelope remain the persistent world; the intervention path and provenance receipt extend that world rather than replacing it with unrelated slides, and the final frame returns to the opening decision.

pacing.rationale: The 728-word explanation runs at about 126 words per minute. Two high-resolution freeze flags were manually inspected and correspond to continuous small-object funnel and channel motion, not pedagogically inert holds.

voice.rationale: The direct narration keeps operational facts, normative judgments, human capacity, task records, privacy constraints, and bounded repository evidence distinct without treating human presence as a safety property.

engagement.rationale: The 12-versus-14-second opening dilemma, viewer prediction, abnormal-case funnel, failed control keys, explicit task check, exercised safe-hold channel, responsibility ceiling, and final return create distinct setup, escalation, test, and payoff moments.

accessibility.rationale: Every state duplicates color with labels, shape, position, line style, enclosure, or explicit crossing; the descriptive transcript covers material changes, all 87 caption cues pass delivery-frame review, and the 16:9 thumbnail remains readable at reduced size.

claim_fidelity.rationale: The master visibly restricts repository proof to finite routing artifacts and denies comprehension, threshold, efficacy, responsibility, deployment, safety, or transfer claims. Safe hold follows failed task conditions, never a inferred trait or score of the reviewer.

non_claim: Passing picture-and-sound lock records final geometry, narration, captions, transcript, thumbnail, timing, and experience review only; release-candidate, independent review, publication, and book-evidence promotion remain ungranted.
